Hi Marissa,

We signed up for a trial and selected the Dedicated capacity option in the dashboard. Our platform processes clinical document summarization and real-time triage; we need to understand how Redwood Dedicated would meet our throughput and latency constraints. High level requirements: ~500 requests/sec (avg), peaks up to 1k rps for short bursts, 95th pct latency target <= 150ms for single-turn generation at ~1k tokens.

Can we schedule a demo focused on Dedicated capacity sizing, multi-GPU throughput, and fallbacks? Also interested in data isolation and SOC2 evidence.

Thanks,

Hi Jenna — great to meet you over email. I'm Aditya (AE, infra/solutions). Looking forward to the Wed 11/18 9:00am PT slot. We'll cover the Dedicated runtime, batching strategies, and a sizing sketch.

Prep notes for the session: can you confirm whether the 500 rps is sustained during the day or only during certain windows? Also helpful: token distribution per endpoint (the attached spreadsheet helps — thanks).

What we'll bring to the demo:
- a short slide with throughput examples (tokens/sec per GPU for the model class you selected),
- autoscaling and burst policies,
- latency SLO tuning (batching vs p95 trade-offs),
- KV/prefix caching approach and warmup strategies,
- SOC2/compliance pack link during the call and a copy of our Dedicated spec sheet afterwards.

I've attached our current Dedicated spec sheet (redwood-dedicated-specs-v2.pdf) and pasted a high-level sizing note below so we can iterate in the call:

Sizing note (example):
- Model profile: Llama-2-13B baseline (optimized kernels)
- Baseline throughput: ~3,000 tokens/sec per A100-equivalent GPU (per our benchmarks) for steady-state batch sizes
- Batching strategy: continuous micro-batching with dynamic timeouts to keep p95 latency under target; expect trade-offs for 95th pct at sub-150ms for short prompts
- Example cluster: 4x A100 for sustained 500 rps mixed workload with burst headroom (tunable by model / quantization)

If you have a procurement timeline, loop in procurement on the call.

See you Wed — sending an invite.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
